I've saved the status update as `status-update.html`. It's one self-contained file in Arkona's brand, with fonts and logo embedded, so you can send it as is.

**Check the dates before you send.** The weekdays in NOTES.md fit the 2025 calendar, not 2026. In 2026, 6 Oct is a Tuesday, 8 Oct a Thursday, 10 Oct a Saturday and 3 Nov a Tuesday. I copied the dates exactly as you wrote them and left the year off. One of the two needs fixing, and the client will see "Fri 10 Oct" in the decision deadline.
